lines.text: God gave faithless Israel a certificate of divorce, and her sister Judah saw it but had no fear.
God told Jeremiah to proclaim toward the south, "Return," and promised to bring them to Zion.
God promised shepherds after His own heart, and people would call Jerusalem The Throne of the LORD.
God told Judah to circumcise their hands to the LORD, or His wrath would burn like fire.
